### Are You Fighting Against God's Will for Your Life?
Author: Michelle S. Lazurek
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/fighting-against-gods-will-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Acts 5:38-39
Points:
- Striving to force doors open by human effort alone ultimately comes to nothing.
- Gamaliel recognized that human movements dissolve, but divine work cannot be stopped.
- Trying to rush ahead of God's plans can put believers in conflict with His purposes.
- Yielding personal timing to the Spirit allows God to open doors effortlessly.

### An Unexpected Ally
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-5-2020.html
Passage: Acts 5:38-39
Points:
- Amid intense anger and hasty judgment, Gamaliel stepped forward with calm, reasoned counsel.
- Gamaliel warned that fighting against a movement from God is fighting God Himself.
- God sovereignly used an unlikely voice to spare the apostles' lives for future ministry.
- Believers facing impossible odds can trust that God places unexpected allies to fulfill His plans.
